blocks.text: Biostatistics applies statistical methods to biological, medical and health-related data. It covers the collection, presentation, analysis and interpretation of data to draw meaningful conclusions. It lets researchers and health professionals make informed decisions about whole populations from sample data, instead of testing entire populations, which may be impractical or costly. For example, by studying a representative subset of workers, biostatistics helps estimate how common a health condition is among all workers.
